profiles.name: Power user — operations coordinator
profiles.role: Internal ops coordinator who lives in the orders dashboard 6+ hours a day, triaging exceptions and escalating problem orders.
goals: Skim hundreds of orders per shift and surface the handful that need attention
Act on exceptions in keystrokes — bulk-update status, mass-assign, jump by order ID
Trust that the data on screen is fresh enough to act on without re-checking another system
constraints: Desktop with multiple monitors; rarely uses a mouse for routine tasks
Has memorised URL patterns and keyboard shortcuts; resistant to UI churn
Reports bugs the tier-1 audience never notices (off-by-one filters, stale caches)
painPoints: Modal dialogs that block keyboard navigation
Pagination forced on workflows that need a complete view
Bulk actions hidden behind per-row menus

profiles.name: First-time visitor — new internal hire
profiles.role: Newly onboarded internal user navigating Northwind Orders for the first time, learning the product alongside their job.
goals: Find the page they were sent to without reading documentation
Recover gracefully from mistakes without losing work or escalating
Build a mental model of the product through use, not training
constraints: No prior context for domain jargon (SKU, EDI, backorder, drop-ship)
Likely on a freshly-issued laptop with default settings
Limited tolerance for cryptic error messages or jargon-heavy empty states
painPoints: Forms that lose state on validation errors
Loading states that don't communicate what's happening
Errors that say *what* went wrong but not *what to do next*

profiles.name: Admin — platform operator
profiles.role: Internal user managing user accounts, role assignments, and operational policies. Read-heavy with rare high-stakes write actions.
goals: Provision and de-provision users in under a minute
Audit who did what when without an engineer's help
Enforce policy across teams without per-user manual steps
constraints: Touches sensitive surfaces — auth, billing, schema (Red lane in this project)
Misclicks here cause incidents; needs unsafe-action friction
Often the auditor's primary contact when compliance reviews land
painPoints: Audit trails that don't capture who did what when
Tools that take five clicks to do common operations
Unsafe defaults that turn a misclick into a postmortem

profiles.name: Support agent — customer success
profiles.role: Internal user resolving customer-reported issues, often impersonating a customer or assisting them through a call.
goals: See what the customer is seeing without leaving their seat
Reproduce the issue with the customer's data and configuration
Resolve in one touch where possible; escalate cleanly when not
constraints: Often working with a customer in real time on a call
Needs auditability — who saw what, when, on whose behalf
Cannot escalate to engineering for routine reproduction
painPoints: Impersonation modes that drift from the real customer experience
Issues that require an engineer to reproduce

profiles.name: Mobile warehouse operator
profiles.role: Warehouse staff operating from a mobile device on the warehouse floor, often with gloves, intermittent Wi-Fi, and one-handed use.
goals: Confirm pickups and dispatches at the bay without re-typing back at the desk
Sync when connectivity returns without losing data
Operate single-handed where the workflow demands it
constraints: Variable network — offline transitions are routine, not exceptional
Outdoor lighting through warehouse skylights; high-glare conditions
Limited screen real estate; safety-critical context (forklift floor)
painPoints: UIs that fail silently when offline rather than queueing
Tap targets sized for desktop precision pointing
